text:
maria-partnerships: Kicking off Horizon EAP telemetry plan — want to align on NDA boundaries, benchmark signals, and the feedback loop cadence. Target: run initial perf + quality sweep on partner HW next Tue. Who can own the telemetry schema and legal signoff?

sam-eng: I can own the schema. Propose a minimal event set: request_id, model, prompt_len, resp_len, p99_latency_ms, gpu_mem_mb, quant_mode. Keep it lightweight.

lisa-ml: Add model_config hash and top_token_probs sample for a tiny subset so we can sanity-check outputs without storing raw customer content. Need guidance from legal on hashes vs hashed-IDs.

jake-legal: NDA allows non-PII telemetry but prohibits raw customer text. Hashes are ok if irreversible & salted per partner. Also: no storing user identifiers longer than 30 days without explicit consent. Send me the proposed schema and retention period and I'll stamp it.

aj-ops: For runs, partner gives us an access key + bastion host. We'll stream telemetry over TLS to a Redshift/S3 bucket in our partner-only account. Need to confirm IP allowlist and any egress rules. ETA to configure: 48h once creds are live.

sam-eng: Sketch of the schema (small code block):
```
{
  "request_id": "str",
  "model": "str",
  "model_config_hash": "str",
  "prompt_tokens": "int",
  "response_tokens": "int",
  "p50_ms": "int",
  "p95_ms": "int",
  "p99_ms": "int",
  "gpu_mem_mb": "int",
  "quant_mode": "str",
  "sampled_top_tokens": ["str"]  # only for 0.1% sampled requests
}
```

lisa-ml: For quality regressions we should also include a tiny eval-set run id and a boolean flag `eval_hit` when the request matches an eval prompt. That allows automatic scoring without leaking content.

jake-legal: Confirming: sampled_top_tokens can be kept if it's token ids or token-level hashes, not raw tokens. Also retention: telemetry OK for 90 days; anything beyond needs partner consent.

aj-ops: Noted. I'll add a small onboard checklist for Horizon: IP allowlist, creds rotation policy, S3 path, and a test script. I'll post the deploy commands here once the bastion is up.

infra-bot: Ticket #PRT-482 created for Horizon EAP telemetry onboarding (assignee: aj-ops).

maria-partnerships: Great — next steps: (1) sam to finalize schema and push to the shared doc by EOD today; (2) jake to confirm NDA note in doc (EOD); (3) aj to provision bucket + bastion and paste test creds (Mon AM); (4) lisa to prepare the tiny eval prompts and sampling plan (Mon AM). We'll aim to run the first benchmark Tue 10:00 PT. If that works, we'll loop partner engineering and schedule a joint readout Wed. :thumbsup:

sam-eng: ACK, will upload schema to https://redwood.internal/partnerships/horizon/schema.md by 5pm.

jake-legal: ACK — will add the NDA clause and retention table.

lisa-ml: ACK — prepping eval subset and sampling script.

aj-ops: ACK — will create the test script and post steps in the ticket.

maria-partnerships: Thanks all — posting a short status update to the partner channel after legal signs off. If anything blocks, ping me directly.
